desc:
🌊 Welcome to Ride a Sea Monster! 🦈

🎣 HOP & TAME: Cast your rod at the next creature and pull yourself on. Ride the waves, dodge giant hazards and tame the rarest monsters!
🐠 COLLECT THEM ALL: From clownfish to colossal whale sharks. Find rare mutations and sizes from Tiny to Colossal!
🗺️ EXPLORE 9 BIOMES: Each one has its own creatures, hazards and secrets.
🐋 BUILD YOUR AQUARIUM: Show off your best creatures swimming in your own giant tank.
💪 TRAIN IN YOUR POOL: Boost your stamina to ride longer and tame bigger creatures.
✈️ FLY AHEAD: Unlock planes to skip straight to the deeper biomes.
📖 COMPLETE THE INDEX: Discover every creature and claim rewards.
👍 Like the game for more updates!
🎮 Supports Desktop, Console, Mobile and Tablet players
